title: 재고관리 선택 차수 목표재고 일괄수정 계약
identityNote: 재고 조정은 업체 비종속이므로 CustKey는 계약 공통 스키마 호환용이며 실제 범위는 OrderYear+OrderWeek+ProdKey다.
displayParity: Nenova FormStockView displays ProductStock.Stock (ns.Stock). The web EXE-parity response must display and edit against mapped currentStock, never a browser recomputation from BeforeStock+WareQuantity-ShipQuantity+StockQuantity, because an unfixed week can legitimately differ.

actions.name: SET_SELECTED_WEEK_TARGET
actions.stockHistory: insert delta from selected-week calculated stock to target
actions.productStock: latest existing stock week only; any later StockMaster causes HISTORICAL_STOCK_EDIT_BLOCKED
actions.laterSnapshotInvariant: historical target editing is blocked when any later OrderYear+OrderWeek StockMaster exists; never create a compensating StockHistory row in a later business week
actions.atomicity: all edited products in one transaction
actions.confirmedScope: 부분확정 차수에서는 수정 대상 ProdKey의 ShipmentDetail만 미확정이면 허용하며, 관련 없는 확정 카테고리 때문에 차단하지 않는다.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026에 같은 OrderWeek가 있어도 선택한 OrderYear의 재고 스냅샷·입고·확정출고·조정만 계산한다.
